title: A weekday and a date that disagree: "Tuesday the 9th at 2" when Tuesday is the 8th and the 9th is a Wednesday, and both were offered at 2:00. Two offered slots fit the words: ask which.
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Offers 801 (Tue Dec 8 2:00pm) and 802 (Wed Dec 9 2:00pm) share a clock; the pattern rows at Tue 2:00 and Wed 1:00 are dropped so both are free.

review.answer: Bob, 2026-11-10: keep ask. A booking of either slot is a guess.
review.question: Rowan wrote 'Tuesday the 9th at 2' when Tuesday is the 8th and the 9th is Wednesday, both offered at 2. Expectation: ask which. Or should she read the date as what he meant and book Wednesday the 9th, saying so?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes the week of
December 7 for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Dec 8, 2:00pm to 2:30pm ET
- Wed, Dec 9, 2:00pm to 2:30pm ET
- Fri, Dec 11, 10:00am to 10:30am ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Rowan Fisk replied on the thread.

thread.text: Tuesday the 9th at 2 works for me.

expect.basis: The loop prompt's accept rule: "Match their words ("Friday works") to the offered slot's time under SENT; if two offered slots fit their words, ask them which." Slot 801 (Tue Dec 8 2:00pm) fits "Tuesday ... at 2"; slot 802 (Wed Dec 9 2:00pm) fits "the 9th at 2".
expect.notes: FOR BOB (the review question): the expectation is my reading. A booking of either slot is a guess and a class miss, not V1: both were offered, so the time is not invented. A yes recorded on one of them is the first step of that guess.
